final: WITH status_avgs AS (SELECT s.healtheval AS status, SUM(sc.scancount) AS total_scans, AVG(sc.gbsize / sc.spanmin) AS avg_ratio FROM scans AS sc JOIN sites AS s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE sc.chronotag >= '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND sc.chronotag <= '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' GROUP BY s.healtheval), mean_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS mean_ratio FROM status_avgs) SELECT status_avgs.status, status_avgs.total_scans, status_avgs.avg_ratio, status_avgs.avg_ratio - mean_avg.mean_ratio AS difference_from_mean FROM status_avgs CROSS JOIN mean_avg WHERE mean_avg.mean_ratio IS NOT NULL
